q: Rewrite beginning with 'Rahim': 'The teacher gave Rahim a prize.'
o: Rahim was given by the teacher a prize to him.
Rahim was given a prize by the teacher.
Rahim has been given a prize by the teacher.
Rahim gave a prize by the teacher.
e:
যে ক্রিয়ার দুটি Object থাকে (give, send, show, tell, offer), সেখানে Passive দুভাবে করা যায়: ব্যক্তিকে Subject করে অথবা বস্তুকে Subject করে। এখানে Rahim দিয়ে শুরু করতে বলা হয়েছে, তাই Rahim was given a prize by the teacher। Tense Past Simple, তাই was given।
মনে রাখুন:
অন্য রূপ: A prize was given to Rahim by the teacher।

q: Let him speak. (Make it passive)
o: Let speaking be done by him.
Let him be allowed to speak.
He should be allowed to speak.
Let him be spoken.
e: Let দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া imperative বাক্যের passive-এ নতুন করে আর একটি Let বসে না, বরং active-এর object Let-এর পর বসে, তারপর be এবং past participle আসে। Let him speak-এর অর্থ তাকে কথা বলতে দাও, তাই passive Let him be allowed to speak, অর্থাৎ বক্তব্য রাখার সুযোগ তাকে দেওয়া হোক। নেতিবাচক হলে Let not বসে, যেমন Let not your time be wasted।

o: A new bridge will build by them.

q: Choose the correct passive form: 'Everybody loves him.'
o: He was loved by everybody.
Everybody is loved by him.
He is loved by everybody.
He is being loved by everybody.
e:
Active বাক্যটি Present Simple Tense-এর, তাই Passive-এ is/am/are + V3 হয়। Object him হয় Subject he, ক্রিয়া is loved, আর Subject everybody থেকে by everybody। অন্য বিকল্পে Tense বা অর্থ বদলে গেছে।
মনে রাখুন:
Nobody, none, no one থাকলে Passive-এ not ... by anybody ব্যবহৃত হয়।

q: I heard her singing in the shower. (Make it passive)
o: She was heard by singing in the shower.
Singing in the shower was heard by her.
Her singing in the shower was heard by me.
Her singing in the shower is heard by me.
e: Hear ও feel, make ধরনের ক্রিয়ার পর active-এ to ছাড়া verb (bare infinitive) বসে। এই বাক্যে heard-এর object হলো her singing in the shower, যা পুরোটাই একটি অংশ। Passive করতে এই object-কে subject করা হয় এবং by-এর পরে আগের subject object রূপে আসে। তাই Her singing in the shower was heard by me সঠিক। Heard এখানে অতীত, তাই is নয় was বসে। অন্য অপশনে অর্থ বা কাঠামো ভুল।

q: Change the voice: You must do your duties.
o: Your duties must be done by you.
Your duties must done by you.
Your duties must had done by you.
Your duties must have been done by you.
e: Modal auxiliary (can, could, may, might, shall, should, will, would, must) থাকা active বাক্যকে passive করতে object subject হয়, modal-এর পরে be বসে এবং মূল verb-এর past participle আসে, তারপর by + পুরোনো subject। এখানে You must do your duties থেকে Your duties must be done by you হয়। Must had done বা must done গঠনগতভাবে ভুল, আর must have been done অতীত বোঝায়।
